name: Kuroume Maki
source:
The second protagonist of [url=/v30959]Ayashigoto Banashi R[/url].

She's in the first year of middle school at the time the story starts.

She thinks of herself as a completely normal girl, but everyone around her thinks she's a bit of a weirdo.

She lives in East Kodamamachi, and she's the last daughter of four children.

She's already able to use magic by the time the story starts. This might come in handy to reseal the Great Spirit Way.

"I'm a magician! I can use magic!! Sorry for keeping it a secret, I guess!!!"

[Translated from the game's character page]
